$comment: Maintainer-editable candidacy evidence for /thesis Section V. Same contract as thesis-disclosure.json: pending fields render the amber chip; filled fields render the value, the asOf date, and a Verify link when given. Values are observations, not claims: zeros and baselines are published as zeros and baselines. Counting rules: Zodiacs.org, Astrofolio, the SDK's own examples, and owner-controlled accounts are never counted as independent; automated wallet/aggregator listings are reported but not counted as citations. Methods and capture evidence for the 2026-07-23 readings are recorded in the closeout release notes.
